settings.title: Delivery
settings.intro: Choose which Lao couriers you work with and what they cost.
settings.step1: The customer picks a courier (and branch pickup or home delivery) at checkout.
settings.step2: You drop the parcel at the courier and enter the tracking number on the order.
settings.step3: For cash on delivery, the courier collects the money and transfers it to you — track it on the COD page.
settings.noneEnabled: No courier is enabled yet — customers can't choose a delivery option until you enable at least one.
settings.feeHint: Fee for picking up at the courier's branch.

payer.destination: Buyer pays the courier at pickup (ປາຍທາງ)

settings.freeOverHint: Optional — leave empty for no free-shipping threshold.
settings.codUnsupported: This courier doesn't offer cash on delivery.
settings.notePlaceholder: e.g. Parcels leave every day at 3 pm
settings.empty: No couriers are available yet. Please contact the admin.

cod.title: Cash on delivery
cod.intro: Follow the cash couriers collect for you: mark it collected when the customer pays, and remitted when the courier transfers it to you.
cod.noOutstanding: Nothing outstanding — every courier has paid you.

admin.title: Couriers
admin.intro: Couriers sellers can offer at checkout. Sellers set their own fees on their Delivery page.
admin.trackingHint: Tracking URL is optional — many Lao couriers only offer tracking in their app. In the template, {'{'}tracking{'}'} is replaced by the parcel's tracking number.
admin.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and _ only, e.g. anousith
admin.codeInvalid: The code may only contain lowercase letters, digits and _.
